title: Create an easy to use API entry to preselect values
body:
Being able to specify default selected values can be very handy in all list-related stuff.

Currently you have to dig inside the helper config etc (seehttp://stackoverflow.com/questions/35437004/algolia-initial-search-parameters-instantsearch-js/35440096#35440096).

Today (feb 16) we had 4-5 people asking for this feature and how to do it (even Algolia employees)

To solve this recurring issue, I propose something like this:

```js
refinementList({
 ...,
 preselectedValues: ['..'],
 cssClasses: {
    preselectedValues: 'hide'
  } 
})
```

What do you think?
